text: An high look: Heb. haughtiness of eyes | the plowing of the wicked: Or, the light of the wicked
destroy them: Heb. saw them, or, dwell with them
a brawling woman: Heb. a woman of contentions | a wide house: Heb. an house of society
findeth no favor: Heb. is not favored
in the wilderness: Heb. in the land of the desert
in proud wrath: Heb. in the wrath of pride
with a wicked mind? Heb. in wickedness
a false witness: Heb. a witness of lies
